## CMS file 

```{r}
#reading in cms data
cms <- read.csv(here("data", "cmshawaii.csv"),
                colClasses = "character")

oahu_ob <- cms %>%
  filter(STATE_CD == "HI",
         FIPS_CNTY_CD == "003",
         PRVDR_CTGRY_CD == "01",
         PGM_TRMNTN_CD == "00",
         OB_SRVC_CD %in% c("1", "2", "3"))
```

exploring oahu obstetric hospitals

note: explain why the cms file is a valid source for hospital obstetrics

```{r}
#claude assisted vis. for xploration purposes, not included in analysis (claude for column name meanings and tables)
oahu_ob <- oahu_ob %>%
  mutate(
    ob_service = case_when(OB_SRVC_CD == "1" ~ "Staff",
                           OB_SRVC_CD == "2" ~ "Under arrangement",
                           OB_SRVC_CD == "3" ~ "Staff and arrangement"),
    nursery    = if_else(NEONTL_NRSRY_SRVC_CD %in% c("1", "2", "3"), "Yes", "No"),
    nicu       = if_else(NEONTL_ICU_SRVC_CD %in% c("1", "2", "3"), "Yes", "No"),
    beds       = as.numeric(BED_CNT),
    cert_date  = as.Date(CRTFCTN_DT, format = "%Y%m%d")
  )

# One-row-per-hospital overview
oahu_ob %>%
  select(FAC_NAME, CITY_NAME, ob_service, nursery, nicu, beds, cert_date) %>%
  arrange(desc(beds))
```

Missing tripler, probably because its a military only hospital. Soo I need to add manually.

```{r}
tripler <- tibble(
  FAC_NAME  = "TRIPLER ARMY MEDICAL CENTER",
  ST_ADR    = "1 JARRETT WHITE RD",
  CITY_NAME = "HONOLULU",
  ZIP_CD    = "96859",
  BED_CNT   = "450"   
)

birth_hospitals <- oahu_ob %>%
  select(FAC_NAME, ST_ADR, CITY_NAME, ZIP_CD, BED_CNT) %>%
  bind_rows(tripler) %>%
  mutate(beds   = as.numeric(BED_CNT),
         source = if_else(FAC_NAME == "TRIPLER ARMY MEDICAL CENTER",
                          "Tripler", "CMS"))

birth_hospitals
```
